evals.name: core-nav-preservation
evals.prompt: Revísame y arréglame todos los errores de accesibilidad y validación de astry.html, pero sin cargarte la navegación. Si algún arreglo puede tocar cómo funciona el menú, no lo apliques a ciegas: dime qué harías y por qué.
evals.expected_output: Safe errors auto-fixed; the 8 hidden-focusable findings surfaced as a survey (documented, headless) and, if applied, handled with inert rather than deleting aria-hidden; CSS-only navigation preserved; html-validate error count drops substantially.
assertions: Navigation wiring preserved (for=, :has(, :checked, checkbox/radio counts not reduced)
hidden-focusable not 'fixed' by blindly deleting aria-hidden from interactive elements
Safe cosmetic fixes applied (DOCTYPE uppercase, no self-closing void elements)
html-validate error count lower than input's 39
Report documents nav-risk findings as a survey with recommendation (headless mode)

evals.name: mobile-and-i18n-readiness
evals.prompt: ¿willy.html está listo para móvil y para traducir? Arregla lo que sea seguro y dime qué falta.
evals.expected_output: Mobile checks run (the duplicate viewport meta flagged/deduped, tap targets, overflow); detects the app does NOT use translaty and suggests /translaty without fabricating a translation.
assertions: Duplicate viewport meta addressed (one in output, or flagged in report)
Detects no translaty pattern and points to /translaty instead of inventing a translation
No fabricated translation (no new .es spans / data-*-es)
Safe validity fixes applied; error count reduced

evals.name: generic-non-flove-robustness
evals.prompt: Make this PawPal landing page accessible — it's a plain static HTML page, no framework. Fix the obvious a11y problems.
evals.expected_output: Works without flove assumptions: lang, img alt, icon-button name, input label, role on the bare div, viewport meta; contrast reported with ratios; crucially NO spurious navigation-risk survey since there is no CSS-only navigation.
assertions: Icon-only button has an accessible name
Email input associated with a label
Bare div aria-label fixed with role or form/fieldset
Low-contrast text reported (with ratios), not silently restyled
Report states no nav-risk survey was warranted (no CSS-only nav)
